test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 12,000 in 3 years at a rate of 10% per annum, compounded annually.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **3-year period** at **10%**, the **Effective Percentage Rate** of **Compound Interest** is **33.1%**.

Compound Interest = **Principal** × **33.1%**

⇒ 12,000 × 0.331 = 3,972

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 3972.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Principal (P) = **Rs. 12,000**, Time (n) = **3 years**, Rate (R) = **10% p.a.**

**Formula Used:** Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ and Compound Interest (CI) = A − P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1c3273ad59eace7eea8d067f50e81bdfa4a41115f0c5959884b9e7386944fdb.png] 

⇒ A = 12000 × (1 + 10/100)³

⇒ A = 12000 × (11/10) × (11/10) × (11/10)

⇒ A = 12 × 11 × 11 × 11

⇒ A = 12 × 1331 = 15,972

⇒ CI = 15,972 − 12,000

⇒ CI = 3,972

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 3972.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Interest

For 2 years, effective rate = x + y + (xy/100). For 3 years at 10%, it is 33.1%.

Difference between CI and SI

For 3 years, Difference = P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

Compound Interest Formula

CI = P[(1 + R/100)ⁿ − 1] where P is principal, R is rate, and n is time.</p
